rv.q: Conductor Daniele Gatti and director Francois Girard marshaled the Met's amazing resources--vocal, orchestral and dance--with a sense of urgency and detail to line that kept the 5 ½ + hour spectacle moving with grace and polish.
Vocally, the Met could not have assembled a better cast.
This "Parsifal" provided a rare occasion when all the elements fused into an overwhelming whole — a true gesamtkunstwerk .

cn.t: Wagner's final opera divides critics with its mystical themes, but the glorious music transcends religious content. The Met's new production attempts to bring coherence to the work's complex spirituality for modern audiences.
